🎯 Welcome to Spear Fishing! 🎯
Grab your harpoon, take aim, and strike!

🐟 A variety of fish with different spawn rates and rarities.
🗡️ Collect, upgrade, and unlock powerful harpoons
⚡ Skill + luck gameplay — precision hits earn big rewards

Ready to hunt?
Aim… throw… and see which fish you can catch!

⭐ Join the group and send feedback! Let us know what you want to see next!
